ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the given diagram, which animals can be considered insectivores?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food-web schematic diagram, with a bird labeled “BIRDS” in the upper right. There are multiple red arrows in the figure representing food relationships, some of which come from small insect or arthropod graphics and point to the bird. Reasoning: The question asks which animals can be considered insectivores. Insectivores refer to animals that feed on insects; in this figure, arrows indicate that the eaten organism points to the feeder. Since the bird receives arrows from insects/arthropods, the bird can be considered an insectivore.
